notes.title: MAC version delay
notes.notes: The PC edition will go ahead on Monday 1st Feb, but the Mac edition will unfortunately be delayed by up to two weeks. This is to ensure that the experiences between all platforms will be exactly the same and avoid any bugs that could arise before sufficient testing. Apologies for the delay but rest assured it will be worth the wait!
